description:
Find tradeable RS3 items by name, returning matches with ID, name, wiki URL and available price, volume and sample timestamp.
- query is a literal item name or prefix: "Abyssal whip" tries an exact match; "abyssal" discovers alternatives. limit defaults to 5, maximum 10. An exact match stops the search even with a larger limit; otherwise wiki opensearch candidates are filtered to GE items.
- Choose a returned ID for get_item_details detail, summarize_price_history statistics or get_price_series daily samples. No matches returns a tool error; optional price fields can be absent and samples lag live offers.
- No auth or local cache. HTTP shares 60 requests/IP/minute by default; honor Retry-After on 429.

query.description: Item name or partial name to search for

name: lookup_item

matches.description: Matching Grand Exchange items, best match first

error.description: Why this row could not be resolved

price.description: Latest price in coins, when known
